title.narrative: Resilience and Recovery in Eastern DRC

description.narrative: Outcome 1. Families in IDP concentration sites have improved their livelihoods. Outcome 2. Fragile communities has strengthened their resilience as their local leaders and other stakeholders have developed their capacity for effective protection of the environment and sustainable management of natural resources. Outcome 3. The discriminatory practices and attitudes that underlie social inequalities, especially those related to gender, are gradually decreasing in the communities following collective and individual actions to restore social, economic and environmental balances carried out in the community by various actors. Outcome 4. Religious leaders, young leaders (women and men) and other local leaders become capable of leading community members into a dynamic of peace, inclusion and peaceful cohabitation. Outcome 5. The three target health structures have improved their capacity to care for pregnant women and provides them with quality maternal health care including testing and family planning
